title: Treasury coupon announcement (5Y TIPS reopening + 2Y FRN reopening + 20Y bond reopening, 6/52-week bills) — the pre-Christmas block, and the confirming primary for three tracked auctions
source: EST: treasury.gov Tentative Schedule of Treasury Auctions PDF (home.treasury.gov/system/files/221/Tentative-Auction-Schedule.pdf), fetched direct by plain curl 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 17,195 bytes) by the treasury-5y-tips-2026-12-22 initial research, text layer inflated stream-by-stream and re-tokenised into 909 tokens. SEVEN securities carry announce date `Thursday, December 17, 2026`, read verbatim from that token stream: `13-Week BILL` and `26-Week BILL` (auction Monday, December 21, 2026), `6-Week BILL` and `52-Week BILL` (auction Tuesday, December 22, 2026), `5-Year TIPS R T` (auction Tuesday, December 22, 2026, settle Thursday, December 31, 2026), and `2-Year FRN R` and `20-Year BOND R` (both auction Wednesday, December 23, 2026, settle Monday, December 28, 2026). Filed estimate on the two limits this lane records: a tentative schedule is tentative by construction, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep — the confirming primary is the announcement itself. The ~11:00 a.m. ET announcement slot is standing convention inherited from the sibling coupon-announcement ledgers and is NOT separately sourced. Discovered in the never-assessed initial research of treasury-5y-tips-2026-12-22, 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED because this calendar already tracks the OTHER December announcement (treasury-coupon-announcement-2026-12-24, researched 2026-09-09, which sizes the 2Y/5Y/7Y note block) while the 12-17 one — which sizes strictly more tracked auctions — existed nowhere, as neither a canonical file nor a proposal. It sits at D-5 of the proposing event, exactly on the corridor boundary. WHY IT IS LOAD-BEARING RATHER THAN ROUTINE: it is simultaneously the confirming primary for THREE separately tracked estimate-dated auctions — treasury-5y-tips-2026-12-22, treasury-2y-frn-2026-12-23 and treasury-20y-bond-2026-12-23 — so a single announcement is what flips all three from `estimate` to `confirmed` and is the one dated observation that can void their like-for-like demand bands at once. It is also where the 5-Year TIPS reopening's size prints: the proposing ledger measures 31 of 31 scheduled 5-Year TIPS reopenings since 2011-08 at exactly $2B below their own CUSIP's new issue (15 of 15 on the December leg), which reads $24B against the $26B sb0590 guides for 2026-10-22, and this announcement is where that arithmetic is either confirmed or broken. A SECOND STRUCTURAL REASON: it is the more compressed of the two December announcements in when-issued terms — it announces Thursday and auctions the TIPS the following Tuesday, a 3-business-day window against the standard 5, the second such case ever on that slot (2020-12-22 is the only precedent). THIS PROPOSAL REGISTERS NOTHING OF ITS OWN. The indirect-share finding, the size base rate and the knot-artifact negative control all belong to docs/research/events/treasury-5y-tips-2026-12-22.md and are deliberately not re-registered here; the FRN's closing-time and spread-inheritance work belongs to treasury-2y-frn-2026-12-23. It exists to give the announcement a calendar row so its own never-assessed research can ask what this lane could not: whether a compressed announce-to-auction window changes what the block clears at. The three bill legs are noted for completeness and are deliberately not filed as events — this calendar tracks no bill auction of any tenor, and creating that class inside an adjacency sweep would be a scope decision rather than a discovery, the same line the 12-24 sibling drew. Proposed as an estimate; `symbols: []` and no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4 + G1) is rates-keyed, so nothing here licenses an entry.
